findings.title: No conditions for life: Women, girls and the gendered dimensions of Israel’s genocide against Palestinians in Gaza
findings.source_type: Primary human rights research report and accompanying press release
findings.affected_population_system: Women and girls; maternal and neonatal healthcare, reproductive healthcare and fertility services. New research documents overwhelmed maternity facilities, shortages affecting pregnancy and delivery care, and shutdown of all IVF services. Report draws on 228 interviews, medical records, verified imagery and other evidence. The study covers 7 October 2023 to 1 October 2026; this is a new publication of research, not a newly occurring clinical incident or a verified change in service capacity during this hour.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Israel’s attacks and blockade have also shut down all IVF services in Gaza

bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Primary research release absent from five authenticated prior heartbeat files; WAFA reporting at 09:07 Palestine time (23:07 PST November 24) falls within discovery window. Primary release exact publication hour not stated.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Confidence high for report publication and accurately attributed findings, not independent confirmation of every underlying claim. Report's legal conclusions are Amnesty's; it says it could not definitively conclude intent to prevent births. Primary report landing page and detailed release read; PDF not analyzed. Research period ends October 1; no claim of new hourly service closure. Production inventory not checked.
